name: ProsperoEden
summary: Unofficial PS5 port of the Eden Nintendo Switch emulator with Vulkan rendering.
description: Runs Nintendo Switch software on PS5 via the Eden emulator tree, rendering through RADV Vulkan. Supports internal resolution scaling up to 4x and multiple controllers. Requires the user to supply their own keys, firmware, and game files.
author: blackbearreloaded
warnings: Does not include keys or firmware — supply your own lawful dumps.
